purpose: Decide whether retained BNR instrument- and currency-specific domestic primary-market issue rates should be transformed into, substituted for, or otherwise treated as the generic sovereign_yield feedback node, while preserving the already retained ECB long-term RON yield source boundary and avoiding post-hoc aggregation.

bnr_primary_market.source: Monthly Bulletin — December 2025, table 12.2 Government securities (new and roll-over issues)
bnr_primary_market.exact_observed_concept: Monthly instrument- and currency-specific primary-market issue yield/interest-rate observations for new and roll-over government securities.
rate_semantics: RON discount Treasury certificates: average yield (% p.a.)
RON interest-bearing government bonds: average interest rate (% p.a.)
EUR Treasury certificates: average interest rate (% p.a.)
EUR interest-bearing government bonds: average interest rate (% p.a.)
inflation-linked RON bonds: accepted margin under the average-interest-rate heading
bnr_primary_market.aggregation_boundary: Provider-published monthly averages by instrument/currency class; no cross-class scalar aggregation is performed in RMD.

ecb_long_term_target.exact_observed_concept: Representative Romanian-leu long-term government-bond interest rate for convergence purposes, monthly average, with maturity as close as possible to ten years residual maturity.

methodology.maturity: as close as possible to ten years residual maturity
methodology.liquidity: selected bonds should be sufficiently liquid
methodology.multi_bond_aggregation: simple average of yields when more than one bond is in the sample

bridge_resolution.resolution: Do not insert the BNR primary-market monthly rates as a required intermediate state in the empirical issuance-yield chain. Retain them as auction-pricing diagnostics. For the long-term sovereign_yield target boundary, prefer the already retained ECB 10-year RON convergence-yield source.

empirical_chain_effect.interpretation: The reviewed empirical chain now matches the existing qualitative supply-pressure to sovereign-yield link. This is a boundary clarification only; it does not make the link equation-ready.

sovereign_yield_node_effect.reason_for_remaining_unresolved: The observed long-term target boundary is available, but the Dynamic Core node has not been canonically narrowed/promoted as a reference mode and no exact supply-pressure-to-yield integrated equation has passed validation.

next_gate.task: Review how the preferred long-term sovereign-yield target can propagate to government_interest_cost through debt maturity, refinancing and re-fixing structure. Do not equate a contemporaneous 10-year yield with the effective interest cost of the outstanding debt stock.
